summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to Shareholders announcing the board-approved distribution of Interest on Equity (the Brazilian equivalent of a dividend) in the gross amount of R$1.5 billion, or R$1,237.5 million net of 17.5% withholding tax. Per-share gross amounts are R$0.19095 (common), R$0.21005 (preferred), and R$0.40100 (unit). Record date is October 20, 2026, ex-date October 21, 2026, payment beginning November 9, 2026. This is a routine capital distribution notice, not a special situation; ADR holders are paid via BNY Mellon. Watch only the confirmation of the 2026 mandatory dividend.
